fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on hurricane preparedness and public communication about storms; discussion of prospects for winter horse racing and betting; criticism and debate over Miami’s proposed convention hall/auditorium plan and its costs; complaints about high winter rents and housing availability; calls for stronger food-safety inspection and coverage of public health topics including a proposed Miami Beach hospital. Also contains local society/entertainment and sports items, advertisements, and columns about Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs.
